candidate.name: Muhammad Rayyan Ahmed
credentials: M.Sc. Data Science (in progress), TU Ilmenau

letter.role_title: Internship in Development of an AI-Based Competitive Database and Product Matching Tool
letter.greeting: Dear Bosch Rexroth Mobile Hydraulics team,
letter.opening: I am applying for the internship on an AI-based competitive database and product matching tool. Extracting structured information from technical documents with LLMs, embeddings and semantic search, and presenting it in a usable prototype, is very close to what I built in my latest project.
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau with a B.S. in Artificial Intelligence. Before my Master's I built relational data models and SQL validations on SAP platforms.

achievements.impact: I built DocuMind (github.com/Rayyan3079/documind-rag), which ingests PDF manuals, embeds them and answers questions with page-level citations; 91% correct on a 22-question test set
I combined semantic search with BM25 keyword search, raising MRR from 0.748 to 0.898, which matters for exact technical terms like part numbers
I built data models with SQL validation in industry, and DocuMind has a FastAPI backend and a Streamlit UI with transparent sources

letter.problems_section: I would structure competitor data from catalogues and datasheets into a database, build AI-supported extraction and a matching method that combines semantic similarity with engineering rules, and validate recommendations with product experts. Hydraulics is new to me, and my German is basic (A1), which I am improving in classes.
letter.closing: I am willing to relocate to Ulm for the 3-month on-site internship and can start by agreement. As a non-EU student I will agree the weekly hours with you so they fit my permitted working days. I would be glad to discuss the role.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am currently learning German (A1).
